sentences.en: The flowers faded in the heat of the summer days.
sentences.zh: 夏天炎热的日子里，花朵都凋谢了。

sentences.en: A delivery man is dropping off an arrangement of artificial flowers.
sentences.zh: 送货车送来一束人造花。

sentences.en: The church is decorated with flowers for the wedding.
sentences.zh: 教堂为婚礼用鲜花进行了装饰。

senses.zh: 花, 花朵开花植物, 花卉精华
